deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Wix website editor and navigate to the "Site" menu. Select "Settings" and then "Advanced Settings". Scroll down to the "Code" section and click on "Add a new site section". Choose "HTML/CSS" as the section type. Paste the following code into the editor: `<form id='returns-reason-form'> <label for='reason'>Reason for Return:</label> <select id='reason' name='reason'> <option value='defective'>Defective</option> <option value='not-as-described'>Not as described</option> <option value='change-of-mind'>Change of mind</option> <option value='other'>Other (please specify)</option> </select> <input type='text' id='other-reason' name='other-reason' placeholder='Please specify reason for return' style='display:none;'> <button type='submit'>Submit</button> </form>`

Click on the "Save" button to save the changes. Then, navigate to the "Settings" menu and select "Payment & Shipping". Scroll down to the "Returns" section and click on the "Edit" button next to "Returns form". Select "Custom form" as the returns form type. In the "Custom form code" field, paste the following code: `<script> document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { const form = document.getElementById('returns-reason-form'); form.addEventListener('submit', function(event) { event.preventDefault(); const reason = document.getElementById('reason').value; const otherReason = document.getElementById('other-reason').value; // Send the form data to your server using AJAX or fetch API // For example: fetch('/returns', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ reason: reason, otherReason: otherReason }) }); }); }); </script>

Click on the "Save" button to save the changes. Now, when a customer initiates a return, they will be presented with the returns reason capture form. The form data will be sent to your server for processing.
